mapper.select: SELECT s.*, res.res_state AS seatState, u.real_name AS occupantName, u.id AS occupantId, ltu.real_name AS longTermOwner FROM seat s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.seat_id, CASE WHEN sr.overstay = 1 THEN 'OVERDUE' WHEN sr.status = 'SEATED' THEN 'SEATED' ELSE 'RESERVED' END AS res_state FROM seat_reservation sr WHERE sr.reserve_date = CURDATE() AND sr.status IN ('WAITING', 'SEATED') ) res ON res.seat_id = s.id LEFT JOIN seat_reservation occ ON occ.seat_id = s.id AND occ.reserve_date = CURDATE() AND occ.status = 'SEATED' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = occ.user_id LEFT JOIN long_term_seat lts ON lts.id = ( SELECT t.id FROM long_term_seat t WHERE t.seat_id = s.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN sys_user ltu ON ltu.id = lts.user_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY s.row_no, s.col_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO seat (room_id, seat_no, row_no, col_no, has_power, status) VALUES
